items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I know Steve Lewis with P-Rone... And that was Steve Lewis. See? Because I heard him a lot of times.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Nobody stuff with stuff Now Steve, he was with P-Rone, and Robichardt a piano player at the Lyric Theater. And Miss Todd used to play with the Tuxedos. Well now they had a big band, but all the rest of them bands used with five pieces and you had no piano.
